description: List or search the airports Villiers can book private jet charters from and to — for building an airport picker or validating an airport before get_jet_estimate / request_jet_confirmation. Excludes airports that cannot take private jets, so every result is a valid airport input for the other tools. Search by IATA / ICAO code, airport name or city, optionally filter by country, and page through the full list with limit/offset. Reference data only: no prices, no availability — a specific route's availability is confirmed at request_jet_confirmation.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Call again with offset=next_offset from the previous response — see has_more/next_offset in the output.

query.description: Optional. IATA / ICAO code, airport name or city, e.g. NCE, EGLL, Nice. Omit to page the whole list.

name: lookup_airports

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page; absent when has_more is false

total_available.description: Total bookable airports matching the filters
